inBrief: This clause describes the ICT products and services covered by the standard and the circumstances in which its requirements apply.

sections.heading: How to use this clause
paragraphs: Use the scope to establish whether the standard applies before selecting detailed requirements from later clauses.
items: Check the product or service boundaries.
Record any parts treated as outside the assessment scope.

inBrief: This clause contains requirements that can apply across several kinds of ICT rather than to only web, documents, software or hardware.

sections.heading: Relationship to later clauses
paragraphs: Read this clause alongside the product-specific requirements in clauses 6 to 13.
items: Do not assume a later product-specific clause replaces applicable generic requirements.

inBrief: This clause applies WCAG 2.2 requirements to web pages. The wording below remains the source for determining the actual requirements.

sections.heading: Choosing the right clause
paragraphs: Use clause 9 for web pages. Non-web documents and non-web software are covered separately.
